codeReview.summary: The fix closes the prior blocker. In dist mode, sqlite-vec resolution is now restricted to the copied artifact's sibling `dist/sqlite-vec` asset, and the build-artifact regression now executes a copied `dist/nya` from a temp package plus a negative missing-asset case, so repo-adjacent `node_modules` can no longer mask a broken dist package.

summary: I reviewed the prior failed review and synthesis, the fix feature metadata, handoff, transcript skeleton, ops-worker skill, and both commit diffs (`29e9a7f` and `0b4545a`). The new resolver removes dist-mode fallback to repo-adjacent `node_modules` (`src/db/sqlite-vec-runtime.ts:65-66`), and the updated regression copies `dist/` into temp for help/doctor/tree-sitter/learn-git checks plus a failing missing-sqlite-vec case (`tests/build-artifact.test.ts:238-245`, `322-385`, `413-456`), so the dist sqlite-vec verification is now self-contained and adequately addresses the original failure.
